turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How does the ad-read voice compare to human voice actors you used before?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: For our A/B tests, listeners couldn't reliably tell which ads used AI voice versus a human actor, and conversion rates were statistically identical. That's a huge win for us cost-wise.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything holding you back from going 100% AI voice for ads?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A couple of our biggest brand clients have policies requiring disclosed human talent for legal/union reasons, so we still keep a human option available for those accounts.
